arStrings.szText: Athrpa has lived in that western alcove since before I became lead archivist. She used to spend hours in the archives. People can live their whole lives without ever seeing a member of the order but she walks among us. I always appreciated that.
LINOS is genuinely fond of ATHRPA and speaks about her kindly.
Just don’t play her in astragaloi. (chuckles) She’ll rob you blind.
